title: Advanced Icosahedral Vector Generation
negative_results: an IcoVector whose checksum does not bind its payload is refused on decode
a corrupted decodable token string is refused on parse
a negative refinement depth is refused
a depth beyond the reused subdivision numerical floor is refused
an unknown body is refused on encode

claims.statement: A GeospatialAddress is mapped (via the ellipsoid outward-normal direction) into a canonical CW-HCM-ICO vector carrying face, octal path, continuous residual, shell/height, and checksum, and is inverted back to the same address to full floating-point precision (POWER); at depth 12 the octal path packs into 36 bits, PACK40-aligned. Generation is deterministic and the token string serializes and re-parses bit-identically.

A face id, an octal path, and a residual are selectors in a synthetic tessellation, not a place; their exact round-trip is a property of the codec, not evidence any source vector identifies a real location.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
